question: Which of the following elements belongs to the s-block of the periodic table?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Calcium**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Calcium** belongs to the **s-block** of the periodic table.
 
• The periodic table is divided into four blocks: **s-block, p-block, d-block, and f-block**, based on the types of atomic orbitals that are being filled.
 
• **s-block elements** include **alkali metals (group 1)** and **alkaline earth metals (group 2)**. Calcium is part of group 2, making it an alkaline earth metal. *Hence, statement regarding Calcium is correct.*
 
• **Iron** belongs to the **d-block** of the periodic table as it is a transition metal. It does not qualify for the s-block. *Hence, Iron does not belong to the s-block.*
